rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities sponsored by an Approved Provider: ACPE-approved or Board-approved providers
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from the general and special CE requirements between initial licensure and first renewal.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; only CEUs from the two years immediately before renewal count.
rules.alternatives: The Board may grant exceptions in emergency or hardship cases or for good cause on written request; exempted pharmacists must pass a Board-approved written examination before renewal.
rules.audit_note: Attest to the number of CEUs on the biennial renewal form; keep certificates for five years and submit proof within 20 days of a Board request.

topics.who: Pharmacists certified under R4-23-411 to administer immunizations, vaccines and emergency medications
Licensees authorized to dispense controlled substances: opioid-, substance use disorder- or addiction-related CE

rules.notes: Licenses are in an even or odd renewal group and renew by Nov 1 of that year (suspended if unpaid). Pharmacists dispensing self-administered hormonal contraceptives under a standing order need 3 contact hours on that subject (no topic code).
